comparison_note: Current cloud PULSE timing versus case-set historical PLECS RPC timing; different hardware/session, not a controlled same-machine speed benchmark. PULSE wall time includes CLI startup, parsing, solving and complete archive writing; excludes C compilation and replay.
accuracy_note: 20 approximately equally spaced existing PLECS grid points including endpoints. Denominator = arithmetic mean(abs(PLECS)) across full 1us grid including endpoints; zero denominators yield null. Full-grid mean/RMS/min/max compared separately. Replay at 1us, no solver output/physics overrides except full original T_END.
archive_note: D1 trajectory bytes cover out.pevt and simulation_report.json; out.pevt bytes are separately reported. PLECS comparison uses original uncompressed waveform CSV chunks.
resource_note: Serial runs; 8 GiB address-space cap; generation wall timeout exactly 5*historical PLECS RPC seconds. Timeout labelled TIMEOUT_5X_PLECS, excluded from completion/accuracy ratios. Replay separate, 600s budget.
